title: An algebro-geometric perspective on the topology of moduli spaces of differentials
summary: Differentials on Riemann surfaces correspond to translation surfaces with conical singularities, and affine transformations acting on them preserve the orders of these singularities. This viewpoint allows the moduli spaces of differentials to appear in various guises across many areas, including algebraic geometry, dynamical systems, combinatorial enumeration, and mathematical physics.
